title: Bonfire Mushroom Patties
description: Crispy air-fried patties of browned mushrooms and tofu with thyme, allspice, and lime.

title: Bright Morning Tofu Scramble
description: Turmeric tofu scramble with crisp golden potatoes, scallions, and a squeeze of lime.

title: Crackle Potato Patties
description: Crisp oven-baked patties of mashed potato, cauliflower, and chickpeas seasoned with thyme and allspice.

title: Ember Jerk Potato Bowl
description: Jerk-marinated potatoes and peppers, air-fried until charred, over brown rice with a coconut-lime drizzle.

title: Firecracker Jerk Tofu Bowl
description: Air-fried jerk tofu and charred cauliflower over brown rice with creamy coconut black beans.

title: Firecracker Squash Boats
description: This dish combines tender spaghetti squash stuffed with a flavorful mixture of black beans, zucchini, brown rice pilaf, and topped with a spicy sauce. The whole meal is cooked in an Instant Pot for maximum convenience.

title: Firelight Lentil Stew
description: Lentils, carrots, and potatoes in a thyme and allspice broth enriched with coconut milk.

title: Golden Coast Coconut Bowl
description: Brown rice bowls topped with steamed potatoes and cauliflower in a thyme-scented coconut sauce with chickpeas.

title: Golden Hour Chickpea Stew
description: Sweet potatoes and chickpeas simmered with thyme, allspice, and light coconut milk, finished with lime.

title: Harvest Moon Chickpea Rice
description: Brown rice and chickpeas cooked with tomatoes, smoked paprika, and cumin, finished with lemon and parsley.

title: Hearthside Cabbage Stew
description: A comforting stew of golden sweet onions, chickpeas, and tender cabbage, warmed with cumin and finished with lemon.

title: Island Breeze Coconut Rice
description: Toasted brown rice cooked in coconut milk with garlic, thyme, and scallion, brightened with lime.

title: Lantern Spinner Dumplings
description: Jamaican-style spinner dumplings simmered in a garlic, thyme, and allspice broth.

title: Monsoon Curry Bowl
description: Potatoes, cauliflower, and chickpeas in a Jamaican curry and coconut sauce, ready in one pot.

title: Night Market Eggplant Stew
description: Eggplant, potato, and red pepper in a red curry coconut broth with lime and basil.

title: Slow Sunday Rundown
description: A Jamaican rundown: potatoes, cauliflower, and chickpeas simmered until the coconut sauce runs down thick.

title: Spice Market Samosas
description: Crisp air-fried samosas filled with spiced potatoes and peas, finished with lime and cilantro.

title: Sunday Rice and Peas
description: Classic Jamaican rice and peas: brown rice and kidney beans cooked in coconut milk with thyme, scallion, and allspice.

title: Velvet Mushroom Gravy
description: A silky, savory gravy of browned mushrooms, thyme, and tamari for rice, mash, or dumplings.
